Gramnota works out a sale price for a 3D print. The app runs on Android and on Windows.

## Which file?

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| [Gramnota.apk](https://github.com/Mahinika/gramnota/releases/download/latest/Gramnota.apk) | Android phone or tablet |
| [Gramnota-Setup.exe](https://github.com/Mahinika/gramnota/releases/download/latest/Gramnota-Setup.exe) | Windows. The installer. Choose this one. |
| [Gramnota-windows.zip](https://github.com/Mahinika/gramnota/releases/download/latest/Gramnota-windows.zip) | Windows, if you do not want to install |

## Installation

### Android

1. Download `Gramnota.apk` and open the file on your phone.
2. If Android asks, allow installation from this source (unknown sources).
3. Open Gramnota and sign in with Google.

### Windows

1. Download `Gramnota-Setup.exe`.
2. If Windows shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**. The installer is unsigned, so that dialog can appear the first time.
3. The installer upgrades a Gramnota that is already installed, in the same place. Windows asks for administrator permission.
4. Start it from the Start menu. Sign-in opens in the browser.

Unpack the zip and start `gramnota.exe`. The same SmartScreen dialog can appear the first time. The Visual C++ libraries are included, so a normal Windows 10 or 11 PC needs nothing extra.
